name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Cheese Enchilada & Spanish Rice Plate
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Warm baked corn tortillas, mild red enchilada sauce, melted cheddar/jack cheese, and tender Spanish white rice make an easily tolerated Mexican staple in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the 1-Entree Cheese Enchilada with Spanish rice and refried beans (or ask to substitute extra rice for the beans if sensitive to legumes).
watchOuts: Sub extra Spanish rice for refried beans if bean skins cause gas
